title: Writing --- With A Clock
label: ch:pt-with-a-clock
canDo: I can fill the six fields of a practical form in Portuguese inside a three-minute clock, and I know how CAPLE's ACESSO pass rule differs from this book's.

payoff.summary: Complete PT-W257-with-a-clock: six form fields against a three-minute timer, stopping when it rings, then one minute on the marks.
payoff.note: The ACESSO facts are the ones portuguese/assessment-spec.md records from CAPLE's pages: A1, four components, about one hour thirty-five minutes, results scaled 55-100% and a single 55% overall pass. ACESSO's writing minutes and word counts are not quoted because they were not verified. The twenty-minute form-and-message shape is the project's own task-shapes/a1.json, and its 60%-per-paper rule is stricter than CAPLE's.
